subject: COLUMN clause
notes: kb/Work PB951. 'PLUS and + are synonyms' (ALL FORMATS). reportColumnOperand : reportRelativeSign? integerLiteral; the relative COLUMN operand is itself a 2002 form (construct report-multi-column-2002), so the synonym is witnessed at 2002+. COLUMN + 2 and COLUMN PLUS 2 place the item at the same column (§13.18.14.4 GR7-GR9).
